planning.title: Gahunda y'Ingengo
planning.subtitle: Intambwe ya FSFSI y'imyaka myinshi na MTEF kugira ngo habe ingingo z'igihugu.
planning.no_assessment_message: Kora isuzuma FSFI k'umwaka w'imari watoranijwe kugira ngo ushobore gahunda na MTEF.
planning.parameters_help: Shira ingingo n'igihe; gahunda y'imyaka myinshi na MTEF y'imyaka 3 bihanitse.
planning.mtef_growth_rate: MTEF igipimo cyo kwiyongera k'ingengo y'imari
planning.budget_increase_hint: Ingengo y'imari yongewe kugira ngo ugeze k'ingongo — si ngaruka y'imari.
planning.section_multiyear_desc: Intambwe, impinduka y'ingengo n'ibyagezweho k'igihe cyatoranijwe.
planning.section_mtef_desc: Gahunda y'imyaka 3 itandukanye, ingongo yayo (% ijanisha) n'iyongera y'ingengo.
planning.trajectory_help: Biteganijwe n'ingongo y'umwaka; urwego rw'icyatsi ni ingongo y'urwego.
planning.insights_help: Kugira ngo habe gahunda y'amategeko n'imyitozo.
planning.mtef_help: Gahunda y'imyaka 3 hamwe n'ijanisha n'iyongera y'ingengo.
planning.mtef_diff_note: MTEF ni gahunda y'imyaka 3 itandukanye: ikoresha ijanisha ry'igipimo n'iyongera y'ingengo. Ingongo y'umwaka 3 = intangiriro × (1 − %), si ingongo y'umwaka 5 y'igirabi. FSFSI biteganijwe bishobora kuba byiza kuruta iyo ingongo niba iyongera y'ingengo ni nini.
planning.saved_plans_help: Fungura gahunda, shyira imwe nk'ikoreshwa ku rwego rw'igihugu, cyangwa utangire gahunda nshya. Hitamo kugeza ku gahunda eshatu kugereranya intambwe.
planning.saved_plans_empty: Nta gahunda yabitswe ku mwaka w'imari. Hanga gahunda hepfo, hanyuma Bika.
planning.viewing_saved: Uri kureba gahunda yabitswe. Hindura ibisabwa ukande Hanga gahunda, cyangwa Tangira gahunda nshya.
planning.compare_help: Ibisabwa hamwe n'intambwe ya FSFSI (gahunda y'imyaka myinshi gusa).
planning.saved_different_assessment: Iyi gahunda yabitswe kuva ku isuzuma ritandukanye. Ongera usuzume niba ukeneye imibare ihuye n'ubu.
planning.save_new_help: Izina ry'ingingo rigomba kuba ridasohoka ku mwaka w'imari (ntabwo ikubiyemo inyuguti). Gushya gahunda gusiba iya mbere yari ikoreshwa.
planning.save_update_help: Guhindura ibisabwa cyangwa ibipimo bishya byongera gutunganya inzira yabitswe. Izina rigomba gukomeza kuba ridasohoka.
planning.delete_confirm: Gusiba burundu iyi gahunda? Ntibishobora gusubizwanyuma.

budget_page.title: Isesengura ry'Ingengo y'Imari
budget_page.subtitle: Amafaranga y' leta yashyizwe ku mpimbano ku myaka myinshi (mds LCU): aho yagiye, uko ibice byahindutse, n'ubwiza bw' amakuru — ku bakoresha ubwenge n'abayobozi. FSFSI, stress, n'ingenzi: Isuzuma, Guteza imbere, Gahunda.
budget_page.scope_note: Ibi biva mu murongo wo guhuza ingengo (IndicatorData), bitari mu isuzuma FSFSI.
budget_page.no_data: Nta makuru y'ingengo yahujwe. Kora import_budget_mapping (intambwe ya 1).
budget_page.metric_hhi_hint: Mu bice by'uburyo bwo kugira ibiribwa
budget_page.chart_share_title: Ibice binini — igice ku mubare wose
budget_page.chart_share_help: % ku mubare wose (bitanu binini ku mwaka wa nyuma).
budget_page.movers_help: Imyanya ikoresha byifuzwa buri mwaka. Impinduka ku rwego na CAGR zikeneye ingengo nziza ku mbere (na CAGR na ku nyuma) ; gutangira ku busa bituma % itaboneka — akabazo. Impinduka y'igice (ppt) : impinduka y'igice cy'impimbano ku mubare w'igihugu.
budget_page.mover_cagr_hint: Guhaguruka kw'ingengo y'impimbano ; gusa iyo mbere n'inyuma ziri hejuru ya zero.
budget_page.mover_level_hint: Impinduka % ku byifuzwa vs umwaka wa mbere ; gusa iyo mbere iri hejuru ya zero.
budget_page.mover_share_hint: Impinduka mu bice bya pasentasi ku mubare w'igihugu (mbere vs nyuma).
budget_page.snapshot_help: Urutonde rwuzuye ku mwaka wa nyuma w'intera.
